title: Etaleness of the invariant principal open of an affine torsor
statement: Let H be a commutative ring, h in H, and C a domain H-algebra finite and faithfully flat over H, with algebraMap H C h nonzero. Let a finite group G act by H-algebra homomorphisms rho, with rho(1)=id and rho(ab)=rho(a) composed with rho(b). Assume D(algebraMap H C h) -> Spec H is etale. Assume that for every field Omega and a,b:C -> Omega agreeing on H, with a(algebraMap H C h) nonzero, there is exactly one zeta in G with a composed with rho(zeta)=b. For any subgroup K of G, let F be the intersection over zeta in K of the equalizer subalgebras of rho(zeta) and id. Then the composite D(algebraMap H F h) -> Spec F -> Spec H is etale. There is no scheme Y, split cover, selected label or map f in this statement.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite Galois covers and finite permutation sets; affine description of subgroup quotients

proof.text: Using basicOpenIsoSpecAway and HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff, convert hEt into Algebra.Etale H (Localization.Away (algebraMap H C h)). Let T = Localization.Away h. IsLocalization.Away.tensorRightEquiv identifies T tensor_H C with this localization. Transport etaleness to the tensor product and apply Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars to obtain etaleness over T. Module finiteness survives base change.

Let sigma(zeta)=rho(zeta.val) for zeta in K. The displayed intersection F equals AlgHom.fixedPoints sigma by Algebra.mem_iInf, AlgHom.mem_equalizer, and AlgHom.mem_fixedPoints. Apply the proved source-library theorem AlgHom.finite_and_etale_fixedPoints to AlgHom.baseChangeFamily T sigma. AlgHom.tensorFixedPointsEquiv identifies its fixed points with T tensor_H AlgHom.fixedPoints sigma, since T is flat over H and K is finite. Thus T tensor_H F is etale over T. These two results are in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.TotallySplit; neither introduces a new proof obligation.

Compose with the etale localization H -> T using Algebra.Etale.comp. The second tensorRightEquiv identifies T tensor_H F with Localization.Away (algebraMap H F h). Transfer etaleness along this H-algebra equivalence and then back to the displayed basic-open map by basicOpenIsoSpecAway and Spec_iff. The domain, nonzero, group-law, faithful-flatness, and rotation hypotheses are not needed for this finite-family fixed-points argument. The theorem signature stays unchanged.

theorem affine_torsor_invariant_puncture_etale
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) (h : H)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra H C] [IsDomain C]
    [Module.Finite H C] [Module.FaithfullyFlat H C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρone : ρ 1 = AlgHom.id H C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (hne : algebraMap H C h ≠ 0)
    (hEt : Etale (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C h)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C))))
    (hrot : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] (a b : C →+* Ω),
      a.comp (algebraMap H C) = b.comp (algebraMap H C) →
      a (algebraMap H C h) ≠ 0 →
      ∃! ζ : G, a.comp (ρ ζ).toRingHom = b)
    (K : Subgroup G) :
    let F := (⨅ ζ : K, AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C)
    Etale (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of F))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H F h)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H F)))
